# Week 9 Start/Sit Briefing -- Monday, 2026-11-02

**Pivoting to Week 9.** `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` still reports Week 8, because tonight's Monday-nighter (CHI@SEA) hasn't been played and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (SEA) is a rostered starter in it. That isn't a real decision -- JSN is this roster's clear WR1 regardless of tonight's result -- so, matching the 10/26 and 10/19 convention, this briefing moves ahead to Week 9 for every other slot.

## Source and freshness -- READ THIS FIRST

The committed Week 9 fixture (`weekly-report-week-9.json`) is a **pre-season placeholder dated 2026-09-08** -- it predates the season and is unusable. This briefing instead comes from a live run of `generate_report.py` executed directly in this sandbox against real `nflreadpy` data, with four degradations versus a normal week:

1. **Zero live injury designations.** ESPN's injury API is proxy-blocked (403) and Sleeper returned 0 rows on this run too.
2. **No Week 9 injury data exists anywhere yet, live or otherwise.** `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` only carries data through Week 8 -- teams haven't started filing for Week 9 (first game Thursday 11/5; reports typically start Wednesday 11/4). I checked Week 8's final report for this roster's players as a lingering-issue sanity check: no flags on Higgins, Skattebo, Likely, or anyone else, so "Healthy" currently looks right rather than just a blank default.
3. **No FantasyPros consensus tier** -- no API key in this sandbox, every player runs on the in-house model alone.
4. **No Rotowire data** (also proxy-blocked).

Tuesday's scheduled CI run has real access to all of the above and will supersede this with a proper fixture -- treat this as a bridge.

## Start these ten -- 142.46 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | vs CLE | **17.34** | 97.2% | 17.85 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs DAL | **16.06** | 95.7% | 16.78 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @ CHI | **15.57** | 95.7% | 16.27 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs ARI | **22.19** | 95.9% | 23.14 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @ ATL | **16.00** | 96.9% | 16.50 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | @ PHI | **14.24** | 95.0% | 14.99 |
| FLEX | Drake London | vs CIN | **15.27** | 97.1% | 15.72 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @ MIA | **12.07** | 96.9% | 12.45 |
| K | Jake Bates | @ MIA | **8.09** | 98.6% | 8.21 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | @ KC | **5.63** | 100% | 5.63 |

**Three swaps off the last briefing's actual lineup (Saturday 10/31, Week 8, 138.57):**

1. **QB: Matthew Stafford -> Tyler Shough (+1.68).** Shough projects 17.34 to Stafford's 15.66 on recent form and a favorable Cleveland matchup. This roster reversed a similar Nix-over-Stafford call in Week 7, so recheck before locking -- but unlike that case, no FantasyPros tier is active either side this run, so it's a cleaner model comparison.
2. **TE: Sam LaPorta -> Isaiah Likely (+3.23).** Likely projects 14.24 to LaPorta's 11.01, reversing LaPorta's hold from the last two briefings.
3. **FLEX: Jalen Coker -> Jameson Williams (+2.47).** Williams (12.07) clears both Coker (10.68) and bench RB Cam Skattebo (11.86, only 0.21 back -- thin, watch).

Bench, all healthy and active this week: Matthew Stafford (QB, 15.66), Bo Nix (QB, 14.93), Cam Skattebo (RB, 11.86), Sam LaPorta (TE, 11.01), Jalen Coker (WR, 10.68).

## Watch list

- **Jameson Williams vs. bench Cam Skattebo at FLEX2** -- 0.21 points apart, inside model noise.
- **Tyler Shough vs. Matthew Stafford at QB** -- a real swap recommendation (+1.68), worth a gut-check against Wednesday/Thursday beat reporting given this roster's track record of reversing similar calls.
- **The entire Week 9 injury report** -- nothing has been filed yet for any player on any team. First filings land Wednesday 11/4; re-run before locking Sunday.

## Opponent notes

- Jaxon Smith-Njigba vs ARI is the clear top play (22.19 expected) regardless of how tonight's Week 8 Monday-nighter against Chicago goes.
- Shough's Week 9 matchup vs Cleveland grades out favorably in-house and is a real driver of the QB call, not just recent box scores.

## Byes ahead -- the headline item this week

- **Week 10:** Bucky Irving (RB, Buccaneers' bye) and bench Bo Nix (Broncos' bye). Irving's bye reopens the RB2 spot for Skattebo, who already covers it on the bench -- no waiver action needed.
- **Week 11: a triple bye.** Matthew Stafford (QB), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR) and Drake London (WR) are all on bye the same week -- Rams, Seahawks and Falcons all idle together. QB is covered by bench Shough/Nix either way. WR is the real exposure: with JSN and London both out, this roster is down to Higgins, Williams and Coker for two WR slots plus whatever FLEX needs. Two weeks out is early to claim a specific replacement, but start watching the Week 10 waiver wire for a streamable WR before Week 11 arrives rather than discovering the hole that week.

## No waiver claim is urgent before this Wednesday

The in-house waiver scan surfaced only kicker options this run (Wil Lutz, Evan McPherson, Andre Szmyt, all ~7.9 expected) -- none better than the rostered Jake Bates (8.09), so no action there. The real planning item is the Week 11 WR bye crunch above, which has a full week of runway before it needs a decision.
